corazon.headline: A new opening built all at once.

corazon.scope: Identity · Content · Menu + Upselling · QR · Website · Acquisition

hero.definition: We built and consolidated the digital presence of a new opening: brand, menu, content, website and acquisition as one system.

list.title: Branding and identity
list.body: Logo, colours, typography and physical and digital applications for a coherent brand in and out of the venue.

list.title: Menu and upselling
list.body: We redesigned the menu and how the offer is presented to increase pizza and complementary-item sales.

list.title: Website and Google Business Profile
list.body: We connected the website, QR and Google profile to turn local search into directions, calls and website clicks.

list.title: Paid Media
list.body: Meta Ads and Google Ads campaigns connected to the website and the offer to generate visibility and demand around the opening.

steps.title: Analysis
steps.body: We analysed the offer, menu, customer journey and Google data to understand where to act.

steps.title: Intervention
steps.body: We redesigned the menu, upselling, website and Google profile as one system.

steps.title: Measurement
steps.body: We tracked sales, local actions and campaigns to read the real results.

steps.title: Optimisation
steps.body: We used the data collected to reinforce what works.

barber.title: Barber Booking
barber.headline: Rethinking booking from both sides of the chair.
barber.support: A booking platform designed for barbershops, exploring how to simplify the customer experience while giving the business more control over scheduling, services, professionals and data.

hero.support: Barber Booking explores a booking experience built for barbershops: simple for the person making the appointment and useful for the business managing it.

problem.heading: Two different experiences share the same calendar.
problem.body: The person booking wants to find a slot and finish in a few steps. The person managing needs to know who's coming, which service they chose, with which professional and how the business is doing.
problem.closing: The product has to simplify both sides.

customer.label: Booking
customer.body: Reduce unnecessary decisions and make finding an available slot immediate.

business.label: Managing
business.body: Give the business a clear operational view without forcing it to jump between different tools.

customer.heading: Fewer steps between intent and appointment.

alts.serviceSelection: Service selection in Barber Booking, mobile app
alts.availability: Availability calendar for booking an appointment in Barber Booking
alts.bookingSummary: Booking summary and confirmation in Barber Booking

status.heading: In development.
status.body: Barber Booking is currently in development. We've built the customer-side booking flow — service selection, availability and confirmation — and designed the architecture that connects services, professionals, availability and appointments in a single system. The management side is designed and will be the next part of the flow to complete.
